title: The Finance Act 2009, Sections 101 and 102 (Penalties for Non-disclosure and Promotion of Tax Avoidance Schemes) (Appointed Day) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints 21st May 2026 as the day on which the provisions concerning late payment and repayment interest set out at sections 101 and 102 of the Finance Act 2009 come into force for the purposes of penalties issued under—

The Armed Forces Pension (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Armed Forces Pension Scheme Order 2005 (S.I. 2005/438) (“the AFPS 2005”), the Armed Forces Early Departure Payments Scheme Order 2005 (S.I. 2005/437) (“the EDP 2005”), the Armed Forces Pension Scheme Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/2336) (“the AFPS 2015”) and the Armed Forces Early Departure Payments Scheme Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/2328) (“the EDP 2015”).

The North Lincolnshire Green Energy Park (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors identified in the North Lincolnshire Green Energy Park Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/362), which granted development consent under the Planning Act 2008, following a request under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

title: The Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 (c. 13). Regulations 3 to 29 amend the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/855) (“the 2019 Regulations”). Regulation 30 amends the Trade, Aircraft and Shipping Sanctions (Civil Enforcement) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 2024/948) (“the TASSCE Regulations”).

summary:
An Act of Senedd Cymru to promote the development of tourism, regulate the provision of visitor accommodation, and establish a directory of visitor accommodation premises.

title: The Television Selection Services (Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations designate a number of television selection services as regulated television selection services for the purposes of Part 3A of the Communications Act 2023 (c. 21) (prominence on television selection services).

title: The Regulated Electronic Programme Guide (Prescribed Description and Transitional Arrangements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations set out a description of an electronic programme guide for the purposes of section 211A(2)(c) of the Communications Act 2003 (c. 21) (“the 2003 Act”).  Any electronic programme guide that falls within this description will be a “regulated electronic programme guide” for the purposes of section 211 of that Act (regulation of independent television services).

title: The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/1249) to refer to a new version of that document. The new version of this document introduces the Authorised Use procedure for frozen bovine, subject to a tariff quota.

title: The Income Tax (Exemption of Kinship Allowance Payments in Kinship Zones) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends section 744 of the Income Tax (Trading and Other Income) Act 2005 to exempt from income tax, sums paid under a pilot scheme known as Kinship Zones under which the Department for Education will provide funding to certain local authorities in England and Wales to provide an allowance for kinship carers.

title: Crofting and Scottish Land Court Act 2026
summary: An Act of the Scottish Parliament to amend crofting law; to provide for the merger of the Scottish Land Court and the Lands Tribunal for Scotland; and for connected purposes.

title: The Online National Health Service Trust (Establishment) Order 2026
summary: This Order establishes a National Health Service trust called the Online National Health Service Trust (“the trust”).

title: The Valuation (Telecommunications, Natural Gas and Water) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: The Valuation (Telecommunications, Natural Gas and Water) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2010, (“the 2010 Regulations”), provide that certain hereditaments of any company listed in the Schedule shall, for the purposes of the Rates (Northern Ireland) Order 1977, be treated as a single hereditament occupied by that company.
